scope: Stage03 Qwen3.5 9B public analysis supplement; synthetic development observations and two separate real trials

field_notes.request_settings: Sent application-level fields; omitted options are not proven explicit engine values. Native parameters are declarations from saved model metadata, not a full runtime-options dump.
field_notes.post_lap_blob_integrity_recorded: null means the saved lap status does not record this field; not a failed integrity check.
field_notes.thinking_field_present_and_nonempty: Presence only. No internal thinking text or continuation-token arrays are published.
field_notes.code_syntax_valid: Recorded static parser result, not a runtime pass.
field_notes.builder_exit_code: Trusted execution bundle field. null means no exit code was recorded; it does not establish execution.
field_notes.cached_input_tokens: Saved API cache metric, or null if absent; do not infer hardware utilization from it.
field_notes.candidate_code_sha256: Opaque digest of a generic synthetic proposal; code is not included. No private real-asset fingerprints are published.
field_notes.real_trial_additional_observations: Manually selected non-identifying facts from retained records; no raw paths, code, images or logs.
field_notes.timings: Relative seconds only; hardware, engine-build and load-state differences limit speed comparisons.
field_notes.case_table_encoding: For each row, pair values with columns in order. This is a lossless table encoding; all 160 cases and all fields are retained.
